name: documents
description: Word documents in your school's template for your agent: a .docx written from Markdown in the template's own styles, with its header, footer and logo kept and its placeholders filled, on your computer, then read back to check it.

description.es: Documentos Word con la plantilla de tu centro para tu agente: un .docx escrito desde Markdown con los estilos de la plantilla, conservando su encabezado, su pie y su logo y rellenando sus campos, en tu ordenador, y leído después para comprobarlo.

en.label: Word documents from your template
en.description: Reports and documents as a .docx in your school's template: its headings, lists, tables and fonts, its header, footer and logo, and its fields filled in, ready to open and review in Word or LibreOffice.

es.label: Documentos Word con tu plantilla
es.description: Informes y documentos como un .docx con la plantilla de tu centro: sus títulos, listas, tablas y letras, su encabezado, su pie y su logo, y sus campos rellenos, listos para abrirlos y revisarlos en Word o LibreOffice.

agent-kit.help: Word documents through my own bundled server: I write a .docx from your template (a .docx or .dotx with your school's styles, header, footer and logo) and Markdown, filling its {{placeholders}}, read a template's styles first and the document back to check it; my documents:docx-from-template skill holds how. Without a template I use a clean A4 one. I never overwrite a file without your yes, and I upload or send nothing.

es.label: Leyendo los datos del servidor de documentos
